summary: Husband of John's 6th-great-grand-aunt Charity Lamoreux (and her first cousin).
bio: Thomas Davenport (1749-1812) came to Plymouth in 1794. After his death in 1812 the estate 'remained in common' until 1820, worked by his sons as 'a commune of themselves' - the 'Davenport congress'.
